summary: Recommends adding # comments to playbooks, roles, inventory and variable files to explain what, how and why.
questions: How do I add comments in Ansible YAML files?

answer_card.title: Use comments
answer_card.answer_md: When names and explicit states aren't enough, add comments (any line starting with `#`) to playbooks, roles, inventory or variable files to explain what something does, how, and why.
